summary: Iteration 2 focused on the new in-app 'Delete my account' feature (App Store compliance). Backend: 27/27 pytest passing (23 regression + 4 new delete-account tests). New /app/backend/tests/test_delete_account.py verifies: (a) DELETE /api/auth/me without token -> 401, (b) DELETE with invalid token -> 401, (c) full cascade — seeds a favorite (lavender-haze) and an event on the ephemeral user, DELETE returns 204, then same token on /auth/me/favorites/events all return 401, login with deleted creds returns 401, email is reusable and the re-registered user has zero favorites and zero events (proves cascade of favorites/events/uploads/custom_photos), and (d) seeded bar@test.com is NOT affected and can still log in. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): registered a throwaway user (deltest_*@test.com/secret123) via the auth modal, verified delete-account-open row on Profile, opened the bottom sheet (delete-account-cancel + delete-account-confirm visible), Cancel dismisses the sheet and keeps the session, then Delete Permanently returns to guest Profile state (profile-login button visible, delete row gone) and attempting to log back in with the deleted credentials shows the 'Invalid email or password' toast (backend 401 observed in console). No React Native red-screen errors. No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not in use).

issues: Pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings persist: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Non-blocking, originates in third-party libs (phosphor-react-native / linear-gradient).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py delete_account (line 214) correctly derives user_id from JWT via Depends(get_current_user); no client-supplied id. Cascade order (favorites -> events -> uploads -> custom_photos -> users) is safe. Consider also revoking uploaded storage objects (currently only DB rows are removed, blob objects in object storage remain orphaned) — not required for App Store review but recommended for GDPR-style hard delete.

profile.tsx: bottom sheet uses snapPoints=['45%'] with index=-1 initial; ref.close() correctly returns index to -1. onSuccess flow (close sheet -> logout -> queryClient.clear -> toast) is idempotent and safe.
profile.tsx line 66: onError shows toast but does not close the sheet — acceptable so the user can retry; consider auto-close on non-network errors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Cancel + Confirm flows both verified, session cleared, deleted creds rejected

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates ephemeral TEST_del_*@example.com and deletes them at end. Frontend test created deltest_*@test.com (deleted by the flow itself). Shared bar@test.com untouched and re-verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://pour-play-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Delete-account endpoint: DELETE /api/auth/me (204, JWT required). Cascade collections: favorites, events, uploads, custom_photos. Auth modal testIDs: auth-name, auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit, auth-toggle. Profile testIDs: profile-login, logout-button, delete-account-open, delete-account-confirm, delete-account-cancel. Auth toggle link text is 'Create an account' (not 'Create account').
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature ships cleanly. All acceptance criteria in review request met: (1) DELETE /api/auth/me cascades favorites/events/uploads/custom_photos, (2) token invalidated post-delete, login returns 401, (3) 401 without token, (4) all existing endpoints unaffected, (5) Profile Delete row + bottom sheet + Cancel/Confirm behavior working.
